app.name: Victory United Launcher
appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.theme_help: "Same as Windows" uses the dark or light setting of Windows and changes with it.
appearance.scale_help: Makes text and buttons in the whole launcher bigger or smaller.
firstrun.title: Welcome to Victory United
firstrun.sub: Two quick steps and you can play.
play.title: Play
firstrun.game_text: Choose the folder of your own copy of the game, the one with MicrosoftGame.Config in it. It can be anywhere. Nothing is copied.
firstrun.drop_hint: or drop the folder onto this window
firstrun.play_text: The first start translates the game's shaders once. Later starts are faster.
play.need_game: Pick your game folder to continue.
play.not_a_game: That is not a game folder: no MicrosoftGame.Config was found there.
play.need_engine: The engine that comes with the launcher is missing. Look in the Updates tab, or download the full Victory United package again.
play.shaders_ready: Shaders are ready. The game starts right away.
play.shaders_cold: The first start translates the game's shaders first.
play.warm_text: The first start translates the game's shaders. This takes a while once and later starts are faster.
play.exit_code: The game ended with exit code {code}.
play.quick_exit: The game stopped within 30 seconds while extra flags were set. They may be the cause.
settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Launcher preferences and settings for the active launch profile.
settings.console_help: Which console the game should think this PC is. Series X is the default; Series S uses less memory.
settings.mode_help: Full screen fills the whole screen with no frame (borderless, like on the console). Window opens a normal window you can move and resize. In the game, F11 or Alt+Enter switches between the two.
settings.window_size_help: The biggest size of the game window. Only used in a window.
settings.screen_help: Which screen the game opens on. The numbers are the ones in the Windows display settings.
settings.safe_help: Turns off every experimental option. Try this first when something goes wrong.
settings.upscaling_one: Only one upscaler runs at a time. Picking one turns the other off.
dlss.title: NVIDIA DLSS
dlss.not_rtx: DLSS needs an NVIDIA RTX graphics card, so it is not available on this PC.
dlss.honest: The game is mostly limited by the processor, so DLSS may help only a little. Try it and compare in the Monitor tab.
dlss.files_note: Folder with NVIDIA's Streamline files (the bin\x64 folder).
dlss.framegen_help: Adds a computed frame between real ones. It can add delay and visible errors when the frame rate is low.
dlss.addon_note: On RTX 20 and 30 cards, frame generation needs a separate add-on folder (dlssg for sm86).
dlss.addon_folder: Folder with the add-on files (version.dll, dlssg_sm86.ini and the dlssg_sm86 folder).
dlss.safe_mode: Safe mode is on, so DLSS is not used.
dlss.nvidia_terms: The DLSS files come from NVIDIA under NVIDIA's terms. This launcher does not include or download them.
dlss.how_to_get: To get them, download the Streamline SDK from NVIDIA (github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/Streamline, release v2.14.16), unpack it anywhere, and choose its bin\x64 folder here.
settings.profiles_help: A profile keeps a preset, the options above and your edits. Switch between them here.
settings.import_failed: That file is not a profile.
settings.engine_none: The engine that comes with the launcher is missing.
settings.bcpack_help: Some engine builds (c21 and c22) need this file to unpack some textures, such as character skin and clothes. Builds from c23 on have the data built in, so you do nothing. A file you choose here, or one named bcpack-tables.bin next to the launcher or in the engine folder, is used instead of the built-in data.
settings.bcpack_missing: No file found. Some textures will look broken (coloured checker patterns).
settings.bcpack_not_needed: No file found. This engine build has the data built in and does not need it.
bcpack.problem_size: it is not the size of a BCPack tables file
bcpack.problem_content: its contents are not BCPack tables
play.bcpack_missing: No BCPack tables file found: some textures, like character skin, will look broken. Add it in Settings, under Engine.
settings.engine_builtin_help: The engine is part of the launcher and is updated together with it.
settings.engine_other_help: Starts your own victory.exe build instead of the built-in one. Only a file called victory.exe is accepted.
engine.problem_name: That is not an engine: the file must be called victory.exe.
engine.problem_launcher: That is the launcher itself, not an engine.
engine.dropped: The engine you had chosen ({path}) is not a Victory United engine, so the built-in one is used again.
firstrun.engine_missing: The engine that comes with the launcher is missing from this folder. Download the full Victory United package again, or look in the Updates tab after you continue.
settings.final_help: Exactly what the engine gets. Lighter lines come from the preset, brighter ones from your changes. Hover a line to see where it comes from.
flags.title: Flags
flags.sub: Every setting the engine reads. For testers and developers: a wrong value can break the game.
flags.mine_help: Added last, so they beat the preset and your edits. Saved next to your settings. Untick a flag to keep it but not use it.
flags.without_help: Starts once with none of the flags above. Nothing is deleted.
flags.bad_name: Names use capital letters, digits and underscores only.
flags.unknown_ok: Not in the list below. It is still passed to the engine.
flags.show_undocumented: Also list the {count} flags that have no description yet
flags.nothing: No flag matches. Clear the search or the filter to see more.
flags.g_plain_help: Known to the engine, but nobody has written down what they do yet. Names only.
flags.add_help: Add this flag to My flags. You can change its value there.
report.title: Bug report
report.sub: Collect what a developer needs. Nothing is sent anywhere: you get a ZIP file to attach yourself.
report.items_help: Untick anything you do not want to include. Your Windows user name and profile folder are replaced by placeholders.
report.saved: Saved {file}. A ready issue text is on your clipboard.
report.demo: Demo mode: no file is written.
report.privacy: The ZIP stays on your PC. Attach it to a GitHub issue yourself if you want to share it.
about.title: About
about.sub: This launcher starts Victory United and keeps its settings.
about.text: You bring your own copy of the game. The launcher never copies, bundles or downloads game files. Victory United is free software.
saves.before_help: Allow up to five seconds to back up changed saves before the game starts.
saves.after: Back up after a clean exit
saves.after_help: Back up changed saves as soon as the game exits normally.
saves.retention_help: Keep recent automatic backups and one per day. The size limit removes older automatic backups first. Set it to 0 for no limit.
saves.folder_help: Choose where new backups go. Use Import and Export to bring backups over from another folder.
saves.title: Saves
saves.subtitle: Back up and restore your saves and the data the game stores.
saves.busy: Close the game before working with backups.
saves.unchanged: There is no new save data to back up.
saves.cleanup_empty: No backups are due for cleanup.
saves.confirm_restore: Replace the current game data with this backup? The launcher first saves the current data.
saves.confirm_cleanup: Delete these backups under your retention settings?
storage.title: Storage
storage.developer_hint: Settings > Storage is where you move or clear the cache.
storage.cache_help: These files speed up startup. The engine can rebuild them after a clear.
storage.data_help: This folder holds saves and other files written by the game.
storage.network: This is a network drive. A slow or lost connection can interrupt the move or the game.
storage.hash_help: Read each copied cache file again to check its contents. Game data always gets this check.
storage.moved: Storage moved. The old folder is still on disk.
storage.interrupted: An unfinished move is ready to resume.
storage.confirm_move: Move {location} to {path}? The old folder stays in place until you choose what to do with it.
storage.clear_cache: Clear the shader and pipeline cache? The next launch may take longer.
storage.clear_data: This removes all saves and game data at the active location. The launcher first backs up your saves. Type CLEAR to continue.
storage.confirm_old: Permanently remove the old folder and everything in it?
behavior.title: Launcher behavior
behavior.after_help: What the launcher does once the game has started. If you close it, the live monitor stops too.
behavior.remember_help: Reopen the launcher where you left it.
behavior.confirm_help: Ask for confirmation before ending the game from Play.
startup_updates.title: Updates
startup_updates.help: Checks GitHub Releases for new builds. The launcher sends no game data or settings and never installs automatically.
play.stop_question: Stop the game? Any unsaved progress will be lost.
play.mesh_blocked: This graphics card does not support mesh shaders. The game needs them to draw its graphics.
play.mesh_override_help: Developers can start anyway to test the engine.
play.mesh_flags_help: Open Play to check your hardware and start the game.
